verdict.rationale: Apify provides scheduling to run Actors periodically (apify-docs-6) and webhooks to trigger notifications/downstream Actors on run completion or failure (apify-docs-14), which are the building blocks a data engineer could use to poll pages and get notified of changes. However, there is no direct evidence of a dedicated change-detection feature, diffing logic, or a documented 'content monitoring' Actor/notification workflow in the pack. Missing for 10: explicit change-detection/diffing capability, a documented monitoring Actor (e.g., content checker), and direct notification channel evidence (email/Slack alerts tied to content changes).
